_description: reglement_ecrit chunk_ids with section=None beyond the single index-0 title-page exception (_is_first_chunk_of_file, check.py) -- a legitimate CONTIGUOUS leading front-matter run, not a stray/unexplained null mid-file. REG1_MS1.pdf's 2026-09-19 Docling section-aware re-ingestion (scratch/ingest_reg1_docling.py) produces a real front-matter/definitions block before its first recognized article-code header that is long enough to char-split into 52 separate chunks (indices 1-52; index 0 already covered by the index-0 exception) -- unlike the old regex chunker (indexer.py's chunk_text_by_article, which the index-0 exception was originally written for) where that same front matter always fit in one chunk. Deliberately a flat chunk_id allowlist, NOT a relaxed 'any leading run is fine' rule in check_metadata_integrity itself -- that would also silently pass tests/test_check.py's single-synthetic-chunk regression case (REG9-5, section=None, no other chunks for that file), which exists specifically to catch a stray null-section chunk anywhere past index 0. aria_rag.check treats exactly these chunk_ids as pass, and fails on any NEW null-section chunk (any file, any index past 0) not documented here.
